hero.tagline: An impressionist journey through light, philosophy & the cosmos

moon.label: I. The Moon
moon.heading: Selene's silver chariot
moon.intro: The night sky has always been a canvas for human projection. We see faces, animals, and gods in the stars — not because they are there, but because the mind seeks meaning in chaos.

philosophy.label: II. The Waves
philosophy.heading: Ego, arrogance & the ocean of self
philosophy.intro: The Bhagavad Gita warns: 'The ego is the greatest enemy of the human soul.' When Arjuna asks Krishna about the nature of the self, the answer is not 'I am great' but 'I am not the doer.'

gita.label: III. The Battlefield
gita.heading: Wisdom from the Bhagavad Gita
gita.intro: The Gita was spoken on a battlefield, not in a temple. Wisdom does not require perfect conditions. The most profound truths are often revealed in the midst of chaos, not in the silence of retreat.

shiva.label: IV. The Dance
shiva.heading: Shiva & the cosmic rhythm
shiva.intro: Shiva sits in meditation on Mount Kailash, the axis mundi, the center of the world. His stillness is not inactivity — it is the stillness of a mind that has transcended all duality, all desire, all fear.

art.label: V. The Canvas
art.heading: Art, beauty & the act of seeing
art.intro: A star field is a reminder of scale. Every point of light is a sun, perhaps with planets, perhaps with life. The universe is not indifferent — it is generous beyond comprehension.
